title: Complete, Rapid Roll-out Solutions for Traffic Management from AT&T and Digi Now Available via NASPO
summary: To support the needs of municipalities in much-needed infrastructure upgrades, NASPO now offers turnkey smart traffic management solutions with pre-negotiated contracts from AT&T Business and Digi International.
